out = os.environ.get('OUT_XLSX')

# Create green fill #00FF00

# Apply green fill to the highlighted cells
for row in highlight_rows:
    cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=1)
    cell.fill = green_fill

# Put the sum value in C2
ws['C2'] = 994110.0

wb.save(out)
print('Done. Sheet3 deleted, cells highlighted, C2 set to 994110.0')

# Verify
wb2 = openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
